sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id" AS e, "Products"."product_color" AS g, AVG("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost") AS m1, AVG(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price")) AS m2, (CAST(AVG(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price")) AS REAL) / AVG("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost")) AS m3 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Products" ON "Products"."product_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id"  GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id", "Products"."product_color") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"
quantities: Invoice_Line_Items.line product cost minus product price per unit
why: average of line total cost including VAT per Products within Products.product_color
line product cost - product price per unit: both in USD and of the same kind (same additivity) on the same one product line on an invoice
average of line product cost minus product price per unit per Products within Products.product_color
average of line product cost minus product price per unit relative to average of line total cost including VAT: both in USD, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
